verdicts.why: The members mark factual kinds of oneness — unpaired, one-person, only-of-its-kind — so the choice is a fact about number, not a verdict.
One reaction (something displeases) rendered at escalating heat from disconcerting through vexing to infuriating, so the pick is a pick of intensity of judgement.
The words divide skill by domain — thought, execution, invention, muscle coordination, hands — and only cunning and light-fingered sound loaded.
Every member specifies a neutral fact about lateral extent or field of view, with no judgement available in the choice.
A single quality, unpleasantness, is graded from plain unpleasant through caustic and vitriolic to hellish; the writer is choosing how hard to hit.
Independence is split across genuinely different domains — economics, persons, politics, mathematics, biology, music labels — which is a factual, not evaluative, difference.
A real split: longtime, long-ago, immemorial and hand-me-down state a fact about duration, while antiquated, antediluvian, archaic and hoary pass a dismissive verdict on the same age.
All name the same neutral state of being not used up, differing only by what is unconsumed — money, supplies, quantity.
The group is an evaluative field scaling praise for one trait, from wise up to sagacious and omniscient and sideways into the faintly mocking owlish.
One behaviour — an unspontaneous, put-on manner — judged at different pitches from mannered and strained to the derisive hokey and plummy.
A textbook case: one body state, several verdicts running from the neutral thin and lean to the alarmed skeletal, cadaverous and wasted.
Substantial halves: uncommon, unusual and unwonted merely report low frequency, while exceptional, especial, special and red-carpet convert that frequency into praise.
The members distinguish cloud from fog from mist from overcast — an observational difference — with only dull and leaden carrying any mood.
Being widely known is one fact, and the group grades the esteem attached to it from noted and notable up through renowned and illustrious to legendary.
The words mark different technical relations of non-connection — digressive, legal moot, mathematical orthogonal, inapplicable — rather than different degrees of disapproval.
Each member names the solvent or the physical process; the difference is entirely chemical fact.
Fully, partly or wholly submerged, salt water or not — the distinctions are positional and biological facts.
Condemnation is constant across the group; what varies is the target or vehicle of the bias — race, sex, sexuality, gender identity, a statement — which is denotation.
These are near-identical technical labels for collective ownership, differing by morphology and scope rather than by any verdict on it.
The members are error terms tied to distinct domains — baseball pitches, targets, fidelity, rule-following — so the choice is factual.
Each names a physical cause or appearance of blocked light: sediment, fog, frost, powder, milkiness, full opacity.
One attachment to country, judged warmly as patriotic and loyal or condemned as chauvinistic, jingoistic and flag-waving — the choice is purely a verdict.
Deviation from the usual is the shared fact, and the words range from the tolerant curious and odd to the dismissive crazy and the repelled grotesque.
The same wish to know is approved as inquisitive and questioning or condemned as nosy, prying and snoopy.
The senses are genuinely different things — an adverse circumstance, a reproving remark, an invidious slight — so the pick is which negative thing is meant.
One kind of conduct, dishonorable behaviour, condemned at varying force and flavour from shabby and inglorious to opprobrious, degrading and the sneering yellow.
The words mark factual states and degrees of agreement — willing to consent, of the same opinion, in complete accord — not warmer or harsher takes on one state.
The members specify the arena of competition — argument, surpassing others, being evenly matched — with only combative carrying much tone.
Genuineness is a verifiable fact here; the members differ by evidential basis and register, not by how favourably they judge.
The group tracks factual social rank — nobility, peerage, title, imperial house — with grandeur an incidental colouring on a few members.
